summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend testing of ProjectPilot MVP. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass covering root, tiers, dashboard, projects CRUD, master/delegation plan generation+materialize, tasks list/tier change, full core flow (run-edit→verify→approve with 400-guardrail on premature approve), human_review reject, preview launch/stop, usage, activity, settings PATCH, 404. Frontend: dashboard renders with all seeded stat cards + panels, all 13 nav routes reachable with no console errors, Projects 'New Project' + 'Load Sample Brief' works, Master Plan/Delegation Plan render, Task Queue lists 11 tasks with tier selectors and Open buttons, Task Details full workflow verified end-to-end (Run AI Edit produced 3-file diff, Run Verification passed and toast shown, Approve & Merge produced commit hash + moved branch back to main), Settings page renders with model-tier reference cards + require-approval toggle. Approve button correctly disabled unless status==pending_approval via canApprove flag in TaskDetails.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 603 lines - close to the 700-line threshold; consider splitting projects/tasks/plans/dashboard routers into separate modules soon.
PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id} accepts arbitrary dict without Pydantic validation - any client can write any field including status. Consider a TaskUpdate model to enforce allowed fields.
PATCH /api/settings accepts arbitrary dict body - same validation gap; strict schema recommended.

verify_task uses seeded RNG that can occasionally return failed for the same task_id - documented as expected but consider exposing a force_pass option for deterministic tests (currently only force_fail exists).
seed_data_creation: No seed created; sample 'Contractor Storage Yard Website' auto-seeded by backend on startup was used. Test project TEST_ProjectPilot_E2E and TEST_MP_gen are created+deleted within tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_projectpilot_api.py and run under pytest-xdist (2 workers). BASE_URL is read from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Note: test_run_edit_verify_approve_flow may PATCH task status to pending_approval if the seeded RNG returns failed verification - this is intentional to keep the flow test deterministic. All data-testids listed in review_request are present and stable.
